messages:
marta_marketing: Quick sync — launching the pricing calculator micro-experiment next week. Need final copy for the FAQ update, a couple tier-name variants to test, and inbound routing rules for webinar registrants. Drafts here: https://docs.redwood.ai/pricing/quick-calc (comments on). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/quick-calc

liam_growth: Can we A/B test 'Team' vs 'Pro Team' as the mid tier label? Small ask: show both estimated monthly and committed discount. Primary metric: click-to-sign and % CS-qualified leads from the calc.

anya_cx: For EU visitors we need VAT phrasing + localized currency display. Also ensure the FAQ links to localized help center articles.

vijay_sales: Routing ask — if a webinar registrant selects 'Sales follow-up' we should create an SDR task via the inbound webhook -> /webhooks/sdr with payload example: {'lead_tier': 'calc_estimate', 'wants_sales_followup': true}. Can product confirm the final property names?

eve_prod: We'll expose a boolean field `wants_sales_followup` and `estimated_monthly_usd` in the registration payload. We can map that to the existing webhook. ETA for hook mapping: Wednesday. Also we'll gate this behind a feature flag `pricing_calc_experiment`.

marta_marketing: Perfect. Also please attach utm_campaign=quickcalc_launch to the reg flow so we can segment in GA.

liam_growth: :thumbsup: I'll add utm params to the reg form and to the webinar CTA.

anya_cx: Copy suggestion for the FAQ snippet: 'How are prices calculated? — The calculator provides an estimate based on your input; final invoices reflect committed usage and applicable taxes. For an exact quote, choose "Sales follow-up".'

marta_marketing: Love it. Tweak 'final invoices' -> 'your committed pricing' and add a link to the Billing FAQ: /help/billing-pricing.

vijay_sales: For routing logic, please include a `region` field so EU leads go to the EMEA SDR queue. Also set enterprise_interest flag when estimate > $5k/mo.

eve_prod: region and enterprise_flag added to the payload plan. Rollout plan for the experiment: 10% -> 30% -> 100% if KPls look good.

marta_marketing: Webinar messaging alignment — we need a 1-paragraph benchmark blurb for the launch post/slide deck about cost-to-performance vs competitors. Draft copy: 'On standard LLM workloads, Redwood's runtime reduces token costs by X–Y% while sustaining sub-100ms tail latency for common request sizes.' Please avoid exact numbers until research confirms.

liam_growth: Agree on placeholders for now. Research to provide ranges before Friday.

anya_cx: Also propose an FAQ example comparing two sample use cases (support bot vs document search) showing estimated cost per 1k tokens so customers have something concrete.

marta_marketing: Volunteers for copy review before EOD Tuesday? @liam_growth @anya_cx @vijay_sales

liam_growth: I can do a morning review Wed.

vijay_sales: I can sanity-check routing logic once webhook is mapped.

ops-bot: Reminder — marketing release checklist due 2025-09-12 09:00 UTC. Link: https://release.redwood.ai/checklists/quickcalc

marta_marketing: Thanks all. I'll update the draft doc with the agreed FAQ snippet and the webinar slide callout. Ping me in-thread with any blockers.
